newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan 100-share index rises above 1,500 points.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan 100-share index rises above 1,500 points.

text.p: The 100-share index of Pakistan's main Karachi Stock Exchange rebounded and rose above the 1,500-point psychological barrier on Wednesday's new accounts day on buying of blue chips by investors, dealers said.
The index, which fell to 1,489.04 points in early trade on selling pressure amid tension over a reported Indian missile deployment, rebounded and rose to 1,500.57 before the close, the dealers said.
India said it had no information on a U.S. report that said it had moved missiles to a site near the Pakistani border.
Heavy buying in blue chips pulled the index up, dealer Azhar Batla of Taurus Securities said.
Pakistan State Oil jumped 8.50 rupees to 320, Brooke Bond 6.00 to 166, Lever Bros 5.0 to 735 and Engro Chemical 3.0 to 131 at 0859 GMT (1359 local).-- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
